answer_1.quote: Feedback comment generation is a task of text-to-text generation.
models: DNN encoder-decoder with a copy mechanism
answer_1.outputs: feedback comments in English for an input sentence and a span

answer_2.quote: In the former, we simply take BLEU between a system output and its corresponding reference (manually created feedback comment).

answer_4.quote: human evaluators examine whether a system output and its corresponding reference are equivalent in meaning.
answer_4.guideline: a system output is regarded as appropriate if (1) it contains information similar to the reference and (2) it does not contain information that is irrelevant to the span
